offerings.name: Centronics FlexiBUS-to-Centronics printer bridge — Aurelia
offerings.implementation: Centronics manufactures and sells one active bridge with a FlexiBUS upstream connection and its existing parallel-printer interface downstream. The 101/101A and P1 remain native Centronics printers. Qualify the cable, BUSY/ACK handshake, character output and available error signals separately for each listed family. The bridge neither converts the printers into native FlexiBUS devices nor promises every Centronics-style printer works. It can be sold independently of a printer; no universal graphics-command translation is implied.
offerings.rationale: Sell a bridge that preserves the Centronics interface and serves existing printers; do not replace that interface with FlexiBUS.
offerings.release_basis: Start from the May 1979 published independent-compatibility programme and demonstrated Aurelia demand. Allow 6 months for vendor interface/product engineering, host software and qualification. Specialist profiles are developed within that interval; month precision expresses an estimate, not an observed shipment.
